items.title: Longsys completes a 3.7 billion yuan private placement at 560 yuan a share, a 45% premium to the latest close

items.summary: CLS, August 8 — Longsys (301308.SZ) said it has completed its share placement to specific investors, issuing 6.6071 million shares at 560.00 yuan each for gross proceeds of 3.7 billion yuan, or 3.668 billion yuan net of issuance costs.
items.summary_zh: 【江波龙完成37亿元定增事项 发行价格为560元/股 较最新收盘价溢价45%】财联社8月8日电，江波龙(301308.SZ)公告称，公司完成向特定对象发行股票，实际发行660.71万股，发行价格为560.00元/股，募集资金总额37亿元，扣除发行费用后净额36.68亿元

items.summary_zh: 【伊朗革命卫队：重开海峡需美国接受伊朗条件】财联社8月8日电，伊朗革命卫队发言人今天（8月8日）表示，重新开放霍尔木兹海峡取决于美国完全接受伊朗的条件，与伊朗当前与阿曼的协商情况无关

items.summary: CLS, August 8 — Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair said on the 8th local time that Iraq's oil exports have fallen 75% because of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
items.summary_zh: 【霍尔木兹海峡关闭致伊拉克石油出口骤降75%】财联社8月8日电，当地时间8日，伊拉克石油部长巴西姆·穆罕默德·胡达伊尔表示，由于霍尔木兹海峡关闭，伊拉克石油出口下降了75%

items.summary: CLS, August 8 — Because of Baihaitun, this year's 13th typhoon, waves of 3-5 metres are expected in the seas off southern Jiangsu from the night of August 8 into the 9th, with waves of 2.5-3.8 metres in coastal waters off Nantong.

items.title: Oil prices stoke inflation while weak jobs undercut the hike case — gold wins on both sides
items.title_zh: 油价刺激通胀、就业削弱加息--黄金“双面得利”
items.summary: This week gold benefited in a rare way from two opposing macro forces at once: oil prices swung sharply on the Iran situation, continually stirring inflation expectations and creating hedging demand for gold, while a shockingly weak employment report battered expectations for a Fed rate hike, pushing the dollar and Treasury yields lower and opening room for gold to rise.
items.summary_zh: 本周，黄金以一种罕见的方式同时受益于两股相互对立的宏观力量：油价围绕伊朗局势剧烈波动，持续搅动通胀预期，为黄金提供保值需求；而一份令市场震惊的疲弱就业数据，则重创美联储加息预期，进一步压低美元和国债收益率，为金价打开上行空间

items.title: Xinjiang trims and standardises self-drive service fees at tourist sites
items.title_zh: 新疆优化调整景区内自驾服务收费
items.summary: CLS, August 8 — Xinjiang's culture and tourism department said on August 8 that, to keep improving the travel environment and pass more benefit to visitors, it has worked with other agencies to guide 4A-rated and higher scenic areas that levy self-drive service fees to adjust their charging models and standards.
items.summary_zh: 【新疆优化调整景区内自驾服务收费】财联社8月8日电，新疆维吾尔自治区文化和旅游厅8月8日消息，为持续优化旅游环境，更大力度惠及广大游客，新疆维吾尔自治区文化和旅游厅联合有关部门指导全区4A级及以上涉收取自驾服务费的旅游景区，对收费模式和标准作出优化调整

items.title_zh: 美国参议院投票确认托德·布兰奇担任司法部长
items.summary: CLS, August 8 — In the early hours of the 8th local time, the Republican-controlled US Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as attorney general by 50 votes to 49.
items.summary_zh: 【美国参议院投票确认托德·布兰奇担任司法部长】财联社8月8日电，当地时间8日凌晨，由共和党控制的美国参议院以50票赞成、49票反对的投票结果，确认托德·布兰奇担任司法部长

items.title: China's national data standards committee: the so-called 'data national standard drafting fee' is charged by impostors
items.title_zh: 全国数标委明确：所谓“数据国家标准编制费”系冒名收取
items.summary: CLS, August 8 — The secretariat of the National Technical Committee on Data Standardization issued a statement saying it has received multiple reports that some organisations or individuals have been impersonating the committee to charge companies improper fees such as a 'data national standard drafting fee', a 'standard name-listing fee' or a 'standard co-drafting fee'.
items.summary_zh: 【全国数标委明确：所谓“数据国家标准编制费”系冒名收取】财联社8月8日电，全国数据标准化技术委员会（简称“全国数标委”）秘书处发布声明：近期，全国数据标准化技术委员会接到多起反映，称有部分单位或个人冒用全国数标委的名义，向企业收取所谓“数据国家标准编制费”“标准挂名费”或“标准参编费”等不正当费用

items.summary_zh: 【美国会参议院通过临时拨款法案】财联社8月8日电，美国国会参议院8日通过一项联邦政府临时拨款法案，以避免联邦政府在现行预算到期后“停摆”

items.title: US Treasury Secretary Bessent: the Strait of Hormuz will 'become irrelevant'
items.title_zh: 美国财长贝森特：霍尔木兹海峡将“变得无关紧要”
items.summary: CLS, August 8 — In an interview with NBC on August 6, US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the Strait of Hormuz will never return to what it was. He stressed this is not the Iran-favourable situation Tehran has portrayed, but rather that the strait will lose its current status as a chokepoint for energy transport.
items.summary_zh: 【美国财长贝森特：霍尔木兹海峡将“变得无关紧要”】财联社8月8日电，美国财长贝森特8月6日在接受美国全国广播公司采访时表示，霍尔木兹海峡永远不会恢复到原来的样子，但他强调，这不是伊朗方面所描绘的那种对伊朗有利的局面，而是指霍尔木兹海峡将失去当前能源运输“咽喉要道”的地位
